nodes.summary: Minimal spec-driven manifest for the memory query truncation bug-fix change, recording the creation date of 2026-07-10. Serves as the machine-readable anchor for this archive change set.

nodes.name: fix-memory-query-truncation design
nodes.summary: Design decisions for fixing deterministic newest-first slice ordering in memory retrieval. Chooses explicit slice-time sorting (O(N log N) on filtered candidates) over pre-sorted storage, specifying exact sort insertion points in handle_query_memory, handle_memory_live_beliefs, and MemoryStore::search_semantic. Includes risk mitigations for sorting overhead and test false-positives on small datasets.

nodes.name: fix-memory-query-truncation proposal
nodes.summary: Change proposal identifying that /memory/query, /memory/beliefs, and search_semantic applied result limits against unsorted insertion-order iterators, discarding newest records. Proposes enforcing timestamp-descending sorting before all truncate/take calls and adding longitudinal integration tests seeding more than limit records to expose the bug. Introduces the deterministic-slice-ordering capability.

nodes.name: fix-memory-query-truncation tasks
nodes.summary: Fully checked-off task list covering four sections: sort-before-truncate fixes in web_server.rs for handle_query_memory and handle_memory_live_beliefs, sort fix in MemoryStore::search_semantic, three longitudinal integration tests in tests/integration/web_server_gaps_sit.rs seeding Day-1 to Day-150 records, and full cargo test suite verification.
